questions.question_text: Find the value of $k > 0$ for which $\int_{0}^{k}(4x + 3)\,dx = 27$.

options.why: Substituted $k$ into the integrand and solved $4k + 3 = 27$ instead of using the primitive.
The other root of $2k^{2} + 3k - 27 = 0$, which must be rejected because $k > 0$.
